work.summary: Completed the VENDRIVE2 release gate, fixed two release-blocking legacy/client-version issues, and validated the full release candidate without adding product scope.
completed: Detected and fixed stale APP_VERSION metadata so release updates are discoverable by existing clients
Detected and fixed legacy VENDRIVE2_DB snapshot-store initialization that could block safe backup restore on fresh or broken v1 databases
Verified the legacy v1 database upgrades non-destructively to internal version 2 and retains the backup format/storage format boundary
Validated Analytics inventory arithmetic, expiry facts, sales observations/windows/comparisons, forecasts, recommendations, visit planning, bring-from-vehicle, and end-of-day loading proposal
Validated OCR reviewed-draft safety with no automatic confirmation, inventory movement, image/raw-OCR retention, or legacy mutation
Validated Analytics backup schemas 2, 3, and 4 including guarded restore and safety snapshot
Validated legacy backup export, future-format rejection, pre-restore checkpoint, restore persistence, and read bridge
Validated exact 320px and 390px Microsoft Edge mobile layouts with no horizontal overflow

releaseRegression.note: Full production-behavior regression passed before release metadata finalization; the terminal-state/release-version gate is rerun after this canonical commit.

coverage: Analytics backup restore requires explicit RESTORE_ANALYTICS confirmation
Analytics restore creates a safety snapshot before replacement
Legacy restore creates a pre-restore checkpoint before replacement
OCR reviewed draft creation does not auto-confirm or apply inventory movement
OCR review flow does not modify vendrive2_v7_data
Legacy backup future format is rejected
real Microsoft Edge on Windows runner
Analytics schema 2/3/4 backup validation and restore
inventory, expiry, analysis, forecast, recommendation, and planning pipelines
sales and input/recovery review approval gates

gates.buildReason: The client is direct HTML/JavaScript. Syntax, diff, functional, data-safety, backup/restore, and real Edge regression gates passed.

nextAction: No active product phase remains. Use VENDRIVE2 as the release-ready baseline and explicitly scope any future product change before editing.
